name: org.colorid/paint-colors
title: ColorID Paint Colors
description: Paint color matching: closest paint to any hex in 35 brands and RAL, search by name or code

tools.name: find_paint_color
tools.description: Look up paint colors by name or color code across 35 paint brands (Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Farrow & Ball, Dulux, Caparol and more) and RAL Classic. Returns each match with its code, hex, RGB, LAB, LRV and colorid.org page. An exact code match comes first. Examples: {"query": "Hale Navy"}, {"query": "SW 7029"}, {"query": "7016", "brand": "ral"}.

brand.description: Optional brand key from list_brands to search one brand only.

tools.name: match_color
tools.description: Find the closest paint color in each brand to a hex color, ranked by CIEDE2000 (ΔE). Only paints within ΔE 6 are returned, each with a verdict: veryClose (under 2), close (under 4) or similar (up to 6). Searches all 35 paint brands unless brands is given; add "ral" to include RAL Classic. Use it to find the same color in another brand: pass that color's hex. Examples: {"hex": "#7F9B8E"}, {"hex": "D4CDC4", "brands": ["sherwin-williams", "benjamin-moore"], "limit": 2}.

hex.description: The color as RRGGBB, with or without #.

brands.description: Optional brand keys from list_brands. Default: all paint brands.

limit.description: How many brands to return, closest first.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List the paint brands and color standards in the ColorID library with their keys and color counts. Use the keys for the brand argument of find_paint_color and match_color. Example: {}.
